title: The Man From the Future Was ME… (Part 2, Finale)
description:
The final part of "My Phone Showed Me the Future" 📱

A stranger in a grey coat saves your life… and leaves behind a phone full of messages. Messages he sent. To YOU.
Twenty years later, you find out who he really was, and how to finally break the loop.

Did you guess the ending? 👀 What would YOU do with tomorrow's news? Tell us in the comments!
